questions.question: The idiom ‘In black and white’ এর অর্থ ----
questions.explanation: 'In black and white' idiom-টির অর্থ লিখিত আকারে (In writing)।

questions.question: The idiom ‘At home’ এর অর্থ ----
questions.explanation: 'At home' idiom-টির অর্থ কোনো বিষয়ে দক্ষ বা সুপরিচিত (Familiar with)।

questions.question: He said,”What a pity!” বাক্যটির সঠিক Indirect speech ----

options.ক: He said that it was a great pity
options.খ: He exclaimed that it was a great pity
options.গ: He exclaimed that it is a great pity
options.ঘ: The exclaimed that it was a great pity

questions.explanation: Exclamatory বাক্যের Indirect রূপ: 'He exclaimed that it was a great pity.'

questions.question: Salim said to me, “I was ill”. বাক্যটির সঠিক Indirect speech ----

options.ক: Salim told me that he had been ill
options.খ: Salim said to me that he was ill
options.গ: Salim told me that I had been ill
options.ঘ: Salim told me that he has been ill

questions.explanation: Direct speech-এর Past Indefinite (was ill) Indirect speech-এ Past Perfect (had been ill) হয়: 'Salim told me that he had been ill.'

questions.question: ‘My uncle looks after me’ বাক্যটির সঠিক Passive form ----

options.ক: I was looked after by my uncle
options.খ: I am look after by my uncle
options.গ: I am being looked after by my uncle
options.ঘ: I am looked after by my uncle

questions.explanation: Present Indefinite Active 'My uncle looks after me'-এর Passive রূপ: 'I am looked after by my uncle.'

questions.question: ‘I saw the boy crying’ বাক্যটির সঠিক Passive form ----

options.ক: The boy is seen crying by me
options.খ: The boy cry was seen by me
options.গ: The boy was seen crying by me
options.ঘ: The boy crying was seen by me

questions.explanation: Past Indefinite Active 'I saw the boy crying'-এর Passive রূপ: 'The boy was seen crying by me.'

questions.question: কোন বাক্যটি শুদ্ধ?

options.খ: I have read a piece of poetry
options.ঘ: The man took his birth in 1968

questions.explanation: 'See' verb-এর পর Bare Infinitive (write) বসে: 'I saw him write something' (আমি তাকে কিছু লিখতে দেখেছিলাম)। কীতে ক সঠিক উত্তর দেওয়া হয়েছে।

questions.question: কোনটি শুদ্ধ বাক্য?

questions.explanation: Comparative degree 'taller'-এর পর Subjective Pronoun 'I' বসে: 'Sohel is taller than I (am).' তাই ক সঠিক।

questions.question: ‘He and I ------well’ বাক্যের শূন্যস্থানে সঠিক শব্দ বসবে ---
